summary: FD_TC_224_3rd Party � Individual with POA (Legal/Tutor/Insurer) � Upload POA � Manual Handoff
title: 3rd Party � Individual with POA (Legal/Tutor/Insurer) � Upload POA � Manual Handoff
description:
Validates that when an individual with legal authority (lawyer, tutor, insurer, financial institution) submits a claim, the system requires POA/authorization upload and routes for manual handling.

Prerequisites:
Third-party caller type: Legal representative / Tutor / Insurer / FI. Not a claims company. Not family/friend.
